maddeler.e:
اعتليت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَلَيْتُ (iʕtalaytu) /iʕ.ta.laj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# اِعْتَلَيْتَ (iʕtalayta) /iʕ.ta.laj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# اِعْتَلَيْتِ (iʕtalayti) /iʕ.ta.laj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# اُعْتُلِيتُ (uʕtulītu) /uʕ.tu.liː.tu/: first-person singular
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
